note: Every regulation fact the document wallet reasons with, each pinned to a sentence its cited page published. Validity clocks, return windows, hunter education requirements and field-display rules only — no fee value appears anywhere in this file, and no eligibility verdict about any person. Where a source states no clock, validity is null and validity_note says why, because silence reads as 'it never expires' and a guess reads as a date. Topics the R11 research could not verify on an official page are absent by decision, not pending: certificate lifetime, a minimum age for the traditional course, junior validation exemptions, penalty amounts outside a quoted sentence, the states that accept California bowhunter education, and any military exemption.

records.title: Hunter Education
records.validity_note: This dataset states no validity period for a course record, because the cited page states none. Read that silence as silence: it is neither an expiry date nor a promise that a certificate lasts indefinitely — check with CDFW.
records.requirement_statement_verbatim: California requires hunter education training for ANYONE who has not formerly held a California hunting license, who does not have a hunter education certificate of completion, or who does not have a current, valid, hunting license or a hunting license issued in either of the two previous years from any state or province.

accepted_proofs.verbatim: Evidence of an annual California hunting license issued in any prior year;
A Two-Day Nonresident California Hunting License issued after the 1999/2000 license year;
A California hunter education certificate or equivalency with a unique number imprinted on it (for example: AA00000) or a California hunter education validation stamp affixed;
A certificate of successful completion of a California-approved hunter education course from any state or province; or
A current hunting license or a hunting license being issued within the two previous years from any state or province.

formats.title: Traditional Hunter Education Course
formats.verbatim: The Hunter Education Course consists of a minimum of 10 hours of classroom, homework, and field instruction in the following areas: firearms safety and handling, sportsmanship and ethics, wildlife management and conservation, archery, black powder, wildlife identification, game care, first aid, and survival. After a student has successfully completed the course of instruction and passed the final examination, they are awarded a Certificate of Completion.

formats.title: Online Course and Follow-up Class
formats.verbatim: Online classes are offered in California, but to obtain a valid hunter education certificate, you must attend and successfully complete a follow-up class with a certified Hunter Education Instructor.
formats.follow_up_verbatim: The online course alone is not a qualification for a hunter education certificate.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Hunting Licenses and Tags page, Frequently Asked Questions
